answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and let only peers with a history of attested work vouch for newcomers. When a juniper grower, a sable courier, and a violet auditor each endorse a new agent, they risk their own bond if that agent cheats, so trust cannot be borrowed for free. An attacker wanting a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand stakes and pass peer review on each one, while an honest agent keeps a single proven identity and reuses it. The cost of attack grows with every Sybil, but the cost of honest participation stays flat.
